# E paper driver (Ongoing)
This project contains files that can create the framebuffer for a bit map also generate frambuffers for text mesaages aswell

# What it does now
* The frame buffer generation works with a given bitmap.
* Texts are getting converted to the required frame buffer.
* the framebuffer generated by my driver is being converted to the expected format given by the IL3895 driver .
* the STM32 integration works and generated framebuffer is being printed by the driver on the e ink display.
  

# What is pending
* A python front end that can accept an image as input and generate a bitmap which then can be fed to my existing driver
